title: Constraint-Guided Enterprise Data Mapping with Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.24218v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise entity alignment must handle semi-structured records, implicit attributes, and unit or granularity mismatches. Manual matching is still common in practice, but does not scale as schemas and providers evolve. LLM-only matching improves semantic recall, yet can violate structural and physical invariants, producing fluent yet operationally invalid correspondences.   We propose constraint-guided mapping (CGM), a neuro-symbolic method with three stages: (i) schema-grounded admissibility constraints with metadata mc = , where tau_c denotes the constraint type and delta_c provides executable relation and normalization logic; (ii) constraint-restricted candidate generation with cascade relaxation to guarantee a nonempty feasible set under noise; and (iii) neural ranking with bounded LLM disambiguation restricted to that feasible set.   Methodologically, constraints operate as hypothesis-space operators rather than post-hoc validators,

translated_title: 约束引导的企业数据映射与大型语言模型
translated_abstract: 企业实体对齐必须处理半结构化记录、隐式属性和单位或粒度不匹配。手动匹配在实践中仍然常见，但随着模式和供应商的发展，它无法扩展。仅使用大型语言模型（LLM）的匹配提高了语义召回率，但可能违反结构和物理不变量，产生流畅但操作上无效的对应关系。我们提出约束引导映射（CGM），一种神经符号方法，包含三个阶段：（i）基于模式的容许性约束，带有元数据mc = ，其中τ_c表示约束类型，δ_c提供可执行的关系和归一化逻辑；（ii）约束限制的候选生成，通过级联松弛来保证在噪声下存在非空可行集；以及（iii）神经排序，受限的LLM消歧仅限于该可行集。方法论上，约束作为假设空间算子而非事后验证器。
tldr: 本文提出了一种神经符号的约束引导映射方法（CGM），将约束作为假设空间算子，通过三阶段流程有效处理企业数据映射中的半结构化记录和不匹配问题，避免LLM产生无效对应关系。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a neuro-symbolic constraint-guided mapping (CGM) method, which treats constraints as hypothesis-space operators through a three-stage process to effectively handle semi-structured records and mismatches in enterprise data mapping, avoiding invalid correspondences from LLMs.
